notes.title: Patch 2023-02-06
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

I've just released a small patch which fixes a few minor issues.

Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed bug on title screen that disallowed certain input during "Press Any Button" prompt
 Updated two file names to protect against potential issues on case-sensitive hardware (no issues have ever been reported, but better safe than sorry)
[/olist]

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Patch 2021-12-12
notes.notes: Fixed issue w/ game not connecting to Steam achievements.

notes.title: Update #8
notes.notes:
Hi my buff blue buddies,

A small hotfix is live, correcting some unforeseen side effects from the recent update of Primal Light to Godot v3.4. Thanks to all the vigilant Kroggies who reported issues on Steam and Discord.

In addition to fixing the above, I've also solved a longstanding problem w/ controller input periodically not registering, which a few people had brought to my and Jeff's attention in the Steam forums.

Changelog:
[olist]
 Fixed issue with bad player physics on moving platforms
 Fixed issue with Wall Crawl Projectiles not following walls in Stage 3 boss fight
 Fixed issue with camera loading in incorrect position when player enters a room with two camera rects
 Fixed issue with Stage 9 boss behavior repetition
 Fixed issue with left/right controller input periodically not registering (happened because of stick + dpad interaction)
 Fixed issue with stick input sensitivity on menus
 Fixed issue with horizontal input on menus changing vertical selection
 Improved Italian localization (thanks, hexaae!) 
[/olist]
As always, please throw any feedback or bug reports you have in the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Steam Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Update #7
notes.notes:
Howdy Krogonians,

The 7th patch of Primal Light is here! The game's engine has been updated to Godot v3.4 in an attempt to resolve a rare issue with less common controllers not being detected (fingers crossed). You can now disable vibrations from the Controller menu as well.

Changelog:
[olist]
 Underlying engine updated to Godot v3.4
 Vibrations can now be disabled from the Controller menu
[/olist]

As always, please throw any feedback you have in the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
Howdy Krogonians,

Update #5 is live! This update brings substantial changes to easy mode, making the game more accessible to those new to the genre. Below is the full changelog.

General
[olist]
 Renamed difficulty modes (Relaxed, Veteran, Hardcore)
 Reference player personas in difficulty mode summaries, so that players have an easier time choosing a difficulty that suits them
 Stages do not restart when you Game Over on Relaxed mode
 Bosses have slightly less HP on Relaxed mode
 You now start with 7 lives on Relaxed mode (rather than 9)
 Merchants now sell 3 lives on Relaxed mode (rather than 2)
 The charm that shows enemy health is now the first charm that you can acquire
 The charm that shows enemy health now shows boss health
 Swapped Max Health Up with collectible in Stage 2 to make it less likely to be missed
 Minor adjustments to Stage 1 terrain
 Slightly extended some platforms in Stage 3 to prevent accidentally sliding off
 Added telegraph to Stage 3 boss lightning attack
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed issue with dashing under spikes in Stage 5 pre-boss room
 Hit box of electric projectile now changes with sprite size
 Fixed issue with Mouth enemies not having health bars
 Corrected 2 lines in Korean translation
[/olist]
If you have any feedback regarding the game, please reach out to us using the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
Howdy Kroglodytes,

Hold onto your butts—the fourth patch of Primal Light is live! This update continues our localization work by adding support for French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese. We've also added a new achievement! Below is the full changelog.

General
[olist]
 Added translations for French, German, & Brazilian Portuguese
 Improved Spanish, Japanese, & Chinese translations
 Added new Steam achievement "No Death Clear" for beating the game without dying
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed issue with playtime—playtime is now calculated as the duration between the end of the first Stage Intro screen and the death of the final boss
 Fixed issue with Spanish translation not working on Stage Intro and Stage Outro screens
[/olist]
If you have any feedback regarding the game, please reach out to us using the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Howdy Krogophiles,

The second patch of Primal Light is live! This patch addresses additional feedback we received since last week's release. The most noteworthy item is a fix for a bug that was causing crashes for Mac and Linux users at the end of Stage 4. Below is the full changelog.

General
[olist]
 Audio settings now persist after closing the game (video settings to come in the future)
 Damage buff duration has been increased from 1 sec to 2 sec
 Added sign before big gap in Stage 1 that reads "Try a late jump!"
 Added fog pit in ledge to ledge room of Stage 5, so players know it's bottomless
 Widened Yeti hurt box
 Changed Yeti position in Stage 6 challenge room
 Added fog pit in ledge to ledge room of Stage 8, so players know it's bottomless
 Added mouths to Stage 8 pre-boss room
 Changed spikes to lava in one section of Stage 9
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed issue with game crashing on Mac and Linux at the end of Stage 4
 Fixed issue with knockback charm applying buff if enemy was on left, regardless of whether it was equipped
 Fixed issue with Stage 7 fireballs that stopped working after Update #1
 Fixed issue with metadata (that is, stage, continues, and deaths) not resetting when you quit to main menu from pause menu, game over, or credits
 Fixed issue with player's shadow not appearing at start of boss sequence
[/olist]
I hope you enjoy these adjustments. Please continue to report bugs and leave feedback in the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Howdy Krogsters,

I am happy to announce that the first patch of Primal Light has just gone live! This patch addresses the most common feedback we received in the first 3 days after release. A summary of the changes is below.

General
[olist]
 The Select Difficulty Menu now shows a description of each difficulty
 Beating the game on one difficulty will now grant you Steam achievements for any easier difficulty
 Cutscenes can now be skipped by holding Jump, Attack, or Enter
 Camera has been adjusted in various rooms making it easier to tell when certain jumps and falls are safe
 Retracting platforms in Stage 3 have been fine tuned with longer timers and less possibility for going out of sync
 Removed first merchant in Stage 8, for better balancing
 Stage 9 boss adjusted to be more dynamic
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed issue causing player to get stuck in crouch mode beneath low one-way platforms
 Fixed issue with bonfire activation persisting across save slots if you quit from the pause menu
 Pressing slide while holding up on a ladder will no longer play the slide sound effect
 Where possible, fixed bottomless pits so that coins do not bounce out of them
 Fixed issue with getting stuck in the geometry on a certain transition in Stage 3
 Fixed issue with enemy sprite overlapping door sprite in Stage 5
[/olist]
Please continue to report bugs and leave feedback in the Bugs and Feedback threads of the Community Page, or in the Primal Light Discord.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
Howdy fellow Kroglings,

The day is here—Primal Light is out now! Jeff and I are happy to finally share it with the world. It's been our dream to release a game, which means this is really a dream come true.

We're both still learning a lot from this, our first game, and we're going to do all we can to ensure people have a good experience post release. If you encounter any bugs with the game, please report them in the bugs channel of the Primal Light Discord or let us know in the  bugs discussion of the Steam community hub! We'll be updating the game as quickly as we can to squash any bugs we've missed!

We are immeasurably grateful to any and all of you who spend your time and money on Primal Light. It's truly an honor that we haven't fully absorbed yet. Thank you sincerely. All that remains to be done is to put on your loincloth and get crackin'.

Best,
Shane

notes.title: Release Approval
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Krogians,

I am thrilled to announce that Steam has officially approved Primal Light for release on July 09, 2020! 

Jeff and I never imagined three years ago when we started whiling away our mortal hours with game dev that we'd be releasing a game on Steam, let alone a game like Primal Light, something that we are immensely proud of. It's a dream come true. We want to give a soulful thanks to all of you who have wishlisted the game, followed us on Twitter, and supported us on the journey so far!

Until release, Jeff and I will be doing QA on the submitted build to iron out any remaining bugs. In the meantime, we wish you all the best.

Sincerely,
Shane
